sister.note: The sister is a dumb terminal: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash with thinking off (the DSv4FNone seat). It may not be dispatched higher by anything but a new brain directive.

subagent.note: A subagent runs at whatever the brain's directive says, within the harvested tier set. It has no vote.

escalation.rule: A subagent may not choose its own tier or thinking effort, in either direction. The brain's directive is the only source; escalation requires a new brain directive.
